notes.title: Now Available for Mac OSX & Linux with Steam Cloud sync!
notes.content:
Fragile Fighter is now available OSX & Linux with Steam Cloud sync.
Also added minor updates like Steam screenshot capabilities and fullscreen options.

notes.title: v1.1 Update 3/5/19
notes.content:
Thank you all for the support and suggestions!
Here is a brief list of the changes in v1.1:

-Reduced lag and frame rate issues.
-Altered enemy damage effects.
-Victoria boss adjustments that better favor the selected difficulty.
-Water level "dance" signs no longer obstruct the path to the doors.
-Various minor bug fixes and tweaks.

Thank you all! <3
(Leave any feedback in the Community Hub)
